title: QualityPolicy
description: Acceptance terms fixed before execution; the canonical hash is committed on-chain as policyHash.

metric.description: The decision metric. Macro-F1 and McNemar are reported, not used to decide.

min_absolute.description: Floor on the final candidate only; early checkpoints cannot meet it.

non_inferiority_margin.description: Passes if the one-sided lower bound of (candidate - reference) is at least -margin.

probation_margin.description: Optional, and only for mid-training checks. Honest training dips between checkpoints. The final check always uses non_inferiority_margin.

probation_steps.description: How far a replacement trains before its first check.

eval_version_hash.description: Hash of evaluation code, image, tokenizer and data.

eval_every_steps.description: null evaluates only at handover and final.
